headline: Fast and reliable
label: positive
text: The setup was quick and the dataset built exactly as documented.

headline: Clear errors
label: negative
text: The build failed until I fixed my mapping, but the error pointed at the exact field.

headline: Good for offline work
label: positive
text: It works offline and the manifest gives me confidence in every release.

headline: Reproducible builds
label: positive
text: Rebuilding from the same source produced identical records and the same manifest identity.

headline: Needs better docs
label: neutral
text: The command works, though I needed to read the configuration reference more than once.

headline: Strict mode helped
label: positive
text: Strict mode stopped a malformed input file instead of silently publishing a partial dataset.
